label: Certiorari granted
caption: OKLAHOMA V. CASTRO-HUERTA, VICTOR M.
text: The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. The case will be set for argument in the April 2022 argument session. Petitioner’s brief on the merits is to be filed on or before Monday, February 28, 2022. Respondent’s brief on the merits is to be filed on or before Monday, March 28, 2022. The reply brief is to be filed in accordance with Rule 25.3.
